name: Deployment Tracking
description: Track and compare canary vs production deployments

prompt.template: Query the activity API at https://activity.metabob.com/health to get the canary version information
Query the activity API production endpoint to get the production version information. If separate production endpoint exists, use it, otherwise note that canary is the active deployment.
Create a comparison table showing the differences between canary and production deployments. Include columns: Service, Canary Version, Production Version, Status.
Query for recent deployment events from the activity API or show deployment-related execution traces. Display as a timeline or table with: Timestamp, Service, Version, Status.
